question: Which two kings marched up to fight against Jerusalem in the days of Ahaz?
options: Rezin king of Aram and Pekah king of Israel
Hiram king of Tyre and Ben-Hadad
explanation: Isaiah 7:1 says King Rezin of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel marched up to fight against Jerusalem, but they could not overpower it.
